## PRB1.7. Investments {#prb1.7.-investments .Heading-2-ER}

- The Union-wide planned total asset value for new investments in RP4 is 5,208M€2022, of which 75.9% relates to new major investments. There are 147 new major investments planned for RP4, of which 82 have started and 65 have not yet started.

- In 2025, at Union-wide level, ANSPs overspent +1.4M€2022 (+6.3%) in costs related to new major investments.

- According to the reporting tables, at Union-wide level, ANSPs underspent -31.8M€2022 (-2.6%) in costs related to investments in 2025 (-22.4M€2022 in en route and -9.4M€2022 in terminal).

- At Union-wide level, ANSPs reported 28.0M€2022 in funding from Union assistance programmes in 2025.
